propositions: Codex has no Serena MCP server entry configured, preventing semantic navigation via the project-required Serena/Pyright toolchain
Project-scoped MCP server configuration must be added to .codex/config.toml to ensure all contributors/worktrees inherit the Serena server without mutating individual global configs

Serena must be pinned to verified upstream commit c7dbe3bd1198cf451bf7aa8fdeeab88571fa3a6e and launched with --context codex and --project-from-cwd flags so each checkout auto-activates without committing user-specific paths

The Serena MCP server configuration must pass structural validation, be discoverable via codex mcp list, survive a negative control test outside the trusted project, and remain non-required so Serena startup failure does not block Codex operation
